snowflake.name: Snowflake
snowflake.summary: A cloud data platform built around SQL warehouses that you size, start and stop.
snowflake.bestWhen: SQL users outnumber coders and you want a warehouse model you size and start.
snowflake.watchOut: Prices are in credits and rise with the edition. Strict security controls sit in higher editions, and Iceberg has documented limits.

databricks.name: Databricks
databricks.summary: A lakehouse platform built on Apache Spark, with notebooks, pipelines, streaming and model training.
databricks.bestWhen: code comes first: Spark pipelines, machine learning and open formats such as Delta Lake and Iceberg.
databricks.watchOut: Classic and Pro compute add a second bill from your cloud provider, and the compliance profile is an extra charge.

both.name: Run both
both.summary: Each vendor's docs show a route to the other's tables through an Iceberg catalog, so some teams give each platform one job.
both.bestWhen: each platform has a clear job, such as Databricks for pipelines and Snowflake for the reporting layer.
both.watchOut: You pay for two bills, two permission models and two sets of skills. We have not tested the catalog setup.
